title: An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud
summary: 调查揭示了通过聚合API密钥、滥用免费试用、代理未受保护的机器人或使用盗刷信用卡等方式，以折扣价转售LLM令牌的市场。主要使用开源API代理软件（如one-api和new-api）实现负载均衡，买家寻求廉价令牌或规避限制。

extra.description: An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud Fascinating investigation by Matt Lenhard into the market that has grown up around reselling LLM tokens at a discount by pooling API keys from various sources. This looks to be mostly a thing in China.
